# Plotting

## Proximity and abundance 

```{r load_data, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

metadata <- 
  tibble(sample = c("S01_CP038_S1", "S02_CP038_S2", "S03_CP038_S3", "S04_CP038_S4"), 
         condition = c("SLE", "HC", "SLE", "HC"), 
         sample_alias = c("SLE1", "HC1", "SLE2", "HC2"))


prox_data <- 
  read_csv("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/clustering_distribution_Bcells_CD21_CD72_toPixelgen.csv")

cells_in_data <- 
  prox_data$component %>% unique()

cells_meta <- 
  prox_data %>% 
  select(component, sample, condition) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  left_join(metadata) 

prox_data %>% 
  unite(contrast, marker_1, marker_2, sep = "/") %>% 
  left_join(metadata) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(condition, log2_ratio, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample_alias), 
              draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  # geom_jitter(aes(group = sample_alias), 
  #             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.85, 
  #                                             jitter.width = 0.1),
  #             size = 0.1) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(group = sample_alias),
                            dodge.width = 0.85, 
                            size = 0.1) +
  # geom_point(data = . %>% 
  #              filter(component %in% c("6b81434111175540", "8a5aa547e333b42c")),
  #            color = "red", size = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
    comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray90")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  facet_wrap(~contrast) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 ratio") 

ggsave("../results/Brodin/brodin_violins.pdf", 
       width = 5, height = 3)

prox_data %>% 
  unite(contrast, marker_1, marker_2, sep = "/") %>% 
  left_join(metadata)


# h5ad data

adata <- 
  anndata::read_h5ad("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/adata_bcells_toPixelgen.h5ad")

seur <- 
  CreateSeuratObject(t(adata$X)) %>% 
  NormalizeData(normalization.method = "CLR", margin = 2) %>% 
  subset(cells = cells_in_data) %>% 
  AddMetaData(metadata = cells_meta %>% 
                column_to_rownames("component")) 

LayerData(seur, "data")[c("CD21", "CD72"), ] %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "marker") %>%
  pivot_longer(-marker, names_to = "component", values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(cells_meta) %>%
  ggplot(aes(condition, clr, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample_alias), 
              draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  # geom_jitter(aes(group = sample_alias), 
  #             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.85, 
  #                                             jitter.width = 0.1),
  #             size = 0.1) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(group = sample_alias),
                            dodge.width = 0.85, 
                            size = 0.1) +
  stat_compare_means(
    # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
    comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray90")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  facet_wrap(~marker) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "CLR") 

ggsave("../results/Brodin/brodin_abundance_violins.pdf", 
       width = 5, height = 3)


###
LayerData(seur, "data")[c("CD21", "CD72"), ] %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "marker") %>%
  pivot_longer(-marker, names_to = "component", values_to = "clr") %>%
  left_join(cells_meta) %>% 
  filter(marker == "CD21") %>% 
  left_join(prox_data %>% 
              filter(marker_1 == marker_2, marker_1 == "CD21") %>% 
              select(marker = marker_1, component, log2_ratio)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(clr, log2_ratio), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(condition, value, fill = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_violin(aes(group = sample_alias), 
              draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  # geom_jitter(aes(group = sample_alias), 
  #             position = position_jitterdodge(dodge.width = 0.85, 
  #                                             jitter.width = 0.1),
  #             size = 0.1) +
  ggbeeswarm::geom_beeswarm(aes(group = sample_alias),
                            dodge.width = 0.85, 
                            size = 0.1) +
  # geom_point(data = . %>% 
  #              filter(component %in% c("6b81434111175540", "8a5aa547e333b42c")),
  #            color = "red", size = 3) +
  stat_compare_means(
    # aes(label = ..p.format..), 
    comparisons = list(c("HC", "SLE")),
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("SLE" = "#E67C81", "HC" = "gray90")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0.05, 0.1))) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2 ratio") 

ggsave("../results/Brodin/brodin_abundance_prox_violins.pdf", 
       width = 4, height = 3)

###

seur %>% 
  DensityScatterPlot(marker1 = "CD45", marker2 = "CD41", facet_vars = "condition") +
  geom_point(data = LayerData(seur) %>%
               t() %>% 
               as_tibble(rownames = "component") %>%
               filter(component %in% c("6b81434111175540", "8a5aa547e333b42c")) %>% 
               left_join(cells_meta) %>% 
               rename(marker1 = CD45, marker2 = CD41),
             shape = 21, 
             size = 5,
             fill = NA,
             color = "red")


```

## 3D plotting

```{r 3d_plotting, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}

plot_data <- 
  list(HC = read_csv("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/3d_visualization_HC_high_clustering_layout_toPixelgen.csv"),
       SLE = read_csv("../data/BrodinLab_pixelgen_data_forpublication/3d_visualization_SLE_high_clustering_layout_toPixelgen.csv")) %>% 
  bind_rows(.id = "type")

plot_data %>%
  arrange(z) %>% 
  # head(10000) %>% 
  mutate(node_type = case_when(
    CD41 == 1 ~ "CD41",
    CD72 == 1 ~ "CD72",
    CD21 == 1 ~ "CD21",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = node_type), 
             size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ type) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CD72" = "#E67C81", "CD21" = "#6A9BD1", "Other" = "gray90", 
                              "CD41" = "#A2D5AB")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_void()

ggsave("../results/Brodin/brodin_3d_plot.pdf", 
       width = 5, height = 3)

LayerData(seur, "data")[, c("6b81434111175540", "8a5aa547e333b42c")] %>% 
  as_tibble(rownames = "marker") %>% 
  arrange(-`8a5aa547e333b42c`) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(`6b81434111175540`, `8a5aa547e333b42c`)) +
  geom_abline() +
  geom_point(size = 0.1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = marker)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 6)) +
  theme_bw()  



plot_data %>%
  arrange(z) %>% 
  # head(10000) %>% 
  mutate(node_type = case_when(
    CD41 == 1 ~ "CD41",
    CD72 == 1 ~ "CD72",
    CD21 == 1 ~ "CD21",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y, fill = node_type, alpha = 0.9)) +
  geom_point_rast(shape = 21, stroke = 0.01, size = 1, raster.dpi = 300,
                  alpha = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~ type) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CD72" = "#E67C81", "CD21" = "#6A9BD1", "Other" = "gray90", 
                              "CD41" = "#A2D5AB")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CD72" = "#E67C81", "CD21" = "#6A9BD1", "Other" = "gray90", 
                              "CD41" = "#A2D5AB")) +
  # scale_color_gradientn(colours = c("#F2F2F2", "#F9D2DF", "#DB8CA6", "#AC4B69", "#781534")) +
  # scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("#F2F2F2", "#F9D2DF", "#DB8CA6", "#AC4B69", "#781534")) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")) +
  ggtitle("CD40")

```
